shared_elements: low-relief carving covering a tall vertical monolithic surface
animal or creature imagery (profile beasts in A; zoomorphic mask forms in B)
repeated small geometric/schematic signs filling bands
justification: Both surfaces are tall vertical monoliths carved in relief with motifs stacked in superimposed registers and some creature imagery, which is the only real correspondence and is of the most generic kind. A shows isolated animals in flat profile silhouette (quadrupeds, waterbirds, a snake-like row) with plenty of empty ground, while B is dominated by a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with an elaborate headdress, deeply undercut and packed edge-to-edge with ornament and sign-like elements; the conventions and the subjects differ almost entirely.
